chunks: As for what Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated, from a man, from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام, he said:
I said: At what age of years is salat (prayer) performed over the child? He عليه السلام said: Salat (prayer) is performed over him in every case, unless he is miscarried before completion.

key_terms.يَسْقُطَ: to be miscarried or dropped from the womb
key_terms.يُصَلَّى: salat (prayer) is performed, here referring to funeral prayer

ai.seo_question: When is funeral salat performed over a child in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning salat (prayer) over a child. It states that the funeral salat is performed for a child in all cases, except when the fetus is miscarried before completion.
